steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...We're already done? No missions for me today either?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Like Dr. Kal'tsit said, just be a good patient and get some rest. Your missions can wait till then.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: How long are we talking here?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Based on your latest tests... you'll require more than a month to recover from your anemia and malnutrition, not to mention your old injuries...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's best that you refrain from any strenuous activities until you fully recover. We'll arrange for your rehab too, so you don't have to worry about that either while you rest.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: More than a month...? But Doctor, I was hired as a mercenary.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I was told there would be missions for me. I'm here to earn my meals, but instead I'm just seeing a doctor and... resting? I don't have the money to pay for treatment anyway.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hm? The onboarding contract should've mentioned that the costs of treatment would be deducted from your salary on a monthly basis. Were you not aware?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'Salary'? What's that mean?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Huh? It's your wages, or remuneration? Uh, pay? You know what I mean?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Uh, yeah, I know what 'pay' is.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Something's not right here. Didn't HR explain the contract before you signed it?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: What's there to explain? I work, you give me money. Back in the unit, those pieces of paper were only to state how many of us there were and how much we'd get paid.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: ...No, that's not how it works. I suggest you go back to HR and let them explain the contract in detail. Not just about the money, but other important terms and conditions you need to be aware of.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I've had employers who refused to pay before, but you guys...
Frostleaf scans Rhodes Island's massive and sophisticated interior.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I've never seen something so huge that can still move, so you guys can definitely afford it.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I just wish I could get assigned a mission soon, or I'll feel strange...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Why do I feel like we keep talking past each other? If you don't want to visit HR, I can only do my part as a doctor and suggest you to head over, and be sure to note down anything you need to be careful of during your recuperation.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: As for now, if you're feeling uneasy, you could always chat with your roommates, or maybe take a stroll on the deck.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: There are different facilities and activity spaces on the middle floors, like the Rec Room, the Reading Room... Go take a look, and enjoy your new life!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hm? Is there anything else?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I just...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Never mind, it's nothing.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Alright, I'll be heading off then!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (I have nothing at all to do... A month of rest time, to enjoy a new life?...What does that even mean?)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ('HR,' 'Rec Room,' 'Reading Room.' Where exactly am I supposed to find those? I can't even read the signs on the doors.)

steps.name: Happy Voice
steps.text: Add flour, then sugar, then stir it all up~

steps.name: Happy Voice
steps.text: Beagle, make sure not to mistake the fleur de sel for powdered sugar this time!

steps.name: Flustered Voice
steps.text: I-I won't!

steps.name: Flustered Voice
steps.text: You're the one who brought up the idea of baking Fang a birthday cookie, but yours ended up exploding in the oven!

steps.name: Happy Voice
steps.text: Hm? No, that was a special surprise~

steps.name: Serious Voice
steps.text: ...I don't think I'd consider that a birthday surprise.

steps.name: Happy Voice
steps.text: You say that now, but I remember how much you were laughing!

steps.name: Serious Voice
steps.text: ...We should keep our voices down. I think we're disturbing that Vulpo over there.

steps.name: Happy Voice
steps.text: Ah, sorry, mate! Wasn't on purpose! Say, you wanna join us?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Ah, me?
Frostleaf looks at the neatly arranged ingredients not far from her.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I don't get it. With those ingredients, you could definitely make some simpler food that'd take less time and provide more calories.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Why waste so much effort making something so crumbly that's hard to carry...

steps.name: Warm Voice
steps.text: Then, what about this scent? Does it help you relax?

steps.name: Warm Voice
steps.text: It was made with the orchids you grew yourself. From planting the seeds to the first bloom, this fragrance wouldn't have been possible without you tending to them daily.

steps.name: Warm Voice
steps.text: The Medical Department usually recommends patients come here often, for a stroll. Whether the aromatherapy or the plants, both are beneficial for your health.

steps.name: Warm Voice
steps.text: Miss Vulpo, you've been standing over there for a while now, is the scent not to your liking? Or would you perhaps like a flower of your own to grow? I can teach you how to take care of it.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: No... It smells nice, and light.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: And thanks, but even if I learned to grow flowers, I don't see myself doing it much... Flowers aren't really useful for anything.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: And even if I were growing wheat, I've never stayed in one place for long, so I wouldn't be the one eating it.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (I can't understand what these instructions are saying... All I remember is to take three of them every day, and the doctor said it should be after meals? Or was it before? And I have to finish them.)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (There are so many pills... I can't tell them apart, so I'll just take them all together. I've always taken medicine like this, and I always feel fine the next day after getting some sleep.)

steps.name: Anxious Voice
steps.text: Wait! What are you doing? You can't just mix those pills!

steps.name: Anxious Voice
steps.text: Don't they come with instructions? How could you... Oh... can you not read them? I know, do you have a notebook? I'll draw a visual aid for you!

steps.name: Anxious Voice
steps.text: Rest assured, I've done this for plenty of other operators! Although I'm just a medical intern, I guarantee my drawings are distinctive and easy to understand!

steps.name: Anxious Voice
steps.text: Look, this one means to take before meals, and the empty bowl means to take them after. I hope you know numbers at least? Okay, I'll just write how many to take here!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I didn't think to bother you with something so small. Usually I figure this stuff out on my own.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I'll remember all this, so don't worry, I won't be bothering you anymore.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (Okay, there's a red flowerpot here, and the plant in it is half-withered and has short round leaves. This is where I get treatment. The word on the doorplate looks like a tail, I'll remember that.)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (Turn right, and go straight in when I see a red door. Then turn left at a blue door. There should be a shelf nearby, where the plants have drooping leaves, and that's where I get my pills.)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (The door with the yellow plants is the Logistics Department for getting daily necessities. The doorplate with words that look a little like two burdenbeasts is the Training Room, where I can do my rehab exercises.)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (I can remember all these the old way. I don't need anyone to draw me a map. People who rely too much on others always end up being left behind by their teammates, sooner or later.)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (The faster I learn all this and meet their goals, the sooner I can get back to the battlefield and work.)

steps.name: Excited Operator
steps.text: We got approval from Logistics? That's great!

steps.name: Excited Operator
steps.text: We can finally get rid of all these old doorplates! And those flowers; it's so hard to grow them without any sunlight in here. Like I've been saying, we should've just given them to the operators to grow themselves!

steps.name: Happy Operator
steps.text: Alright, let's get going and grab our stuff from Logistics so we can clean this place up properly!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (...When will I be considered well enough to start going on missions?)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (I'm a mercenary, aren't I? I've been here so long, and what am I doing? I spend my days making sweets, growing flowers, and being dragged off to pet small animals... What use is all this?)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (I'm supposed to be fighting for them, but it seems like they don't need me at all. And I'm pretty much useless at anything else: whether taking my medicine or finding my way around, I always end up needing somebody's help.)

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (...What exactly am I here for?)
Her roommates are all out on missions, and Frostleaf is alone in the dormitory with a pile of small gifts from operators she doesn't know.

There are a few books and brochures she can't understand, some snacks, a few potted plants, and a pair of headphones. Compared to the packages she would receive as a mercenary, they were both more expensive and less necessary.
Frostleaf puts on the headphones like she had seen someone else do before, as if they could isolate her from all the annoying things in the outside world.
A soothing rhythm and constant humming combine with some incomprehensible words, and Frostleaf hums along with the melody.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ♪Hmm...Hm-hmm...♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Phew... I think I've calmed down.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: (I can't understand the rest.)

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Frostleaf, I think that's enough training for today. Any more practice might put a strain on your body.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You're so strong, Frostleaf... You're in the middle of recuperating, but I still can't keep up with you sometimes.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Jessica, she won't be able to practice with you any more for today.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Gotcha, I'll do my best on my own!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The methods us wandering mercs use are definitely different from yours, but you're strong too.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You really think so?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The doctor must also be able to tell you're getting stronger, since she's giving me less and less time to spar with you.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Right, which is why I must always be here to observe. Over here, Frostleaf, I need to collect some post-exercise data.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: By the way, are you listening to music? I've seen you with headphones on a lot lately. Have you finally found something you enjoy?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Uh... it's okay? I just feel less on edge after listening to this song.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Don't worry, your body is recovering much faster than we expected, so you might even pass the next physical exam.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: For real?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: But♪...yesterday...shed tears...♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Chasing♪...throw away...♪

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Seems like you're in high spirits. I got the data I needed, so I'll get going! We're always so busy over at Medical. Just get a bit more rest and you'll be good to go.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Uh, Doctor, I want to ask, do you know this song?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: What song? ...No, I've never heard it. Why?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I just wanted to know what it's about. I feel like it's a peaceful story.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I think there's some sort of book sharing session in the activity room right now, maybe you could join them?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...Forget it, I've never needed to read. I just wanted to know what the song is about.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hm... Then I recommend you head over to the reading room. They have some dictionaries you could borrow. Would you like me to take you? Do you know the way?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...I would, if they didn't replace all the plants and doorplates.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Nothing! I can go by myself, thank you!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: *muddled pronunciation*? or is it *muddled pronunciation*?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: A word that looks like weeds, and behind is a hook that looks like a tail... Does this mean 'starry sky'?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: *muddled pronunciation* ...'lost'...'witness'......

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'tears'...'drunk'......

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'Tears drunk, look at lost starry sky, light up, passing by crazy young people'......

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'Sad light, but it can't be done, throw it away, throw it away, dance and cry'?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I've written down the meanings of each word, but what does the line actually mean...?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Is it even meant to be understood? Or did I read it wrong? But that's what it says in the dictionary, so there shouldn't be any problems.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: What's going on...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Tears drunk—♪♪Throw away, throw away, dance and cry♪ Um...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...That sounds so weird, and so bad! There's no way they sung it like that. Now I'm even more annoyed!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...I really can't do a single thing right.
Frostleaf throws off her headphones in a huff, and a fragmented voice seeps out from the earcups, floating into her ears.
Hm—hm-hmmm♪ Hmm.......hm-hmm......♪
♪Hmm...Hm-hmm...♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I don't believe it.
The gifts from her fellow operators were still piled up on her desk, and Frostleaf takes out a vocabulary book she'd put away in a drawer.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'I, eat, biscuit. Subject, verb, object.'

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'I happily eat, the, delicious biscuit. Adverb, article, adjective.'

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: '...Using modifiers can make your sentences more rich and complete.'

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Then that 'tears drunk' is actually...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'Drunk on tears'? If I add the words before it, 'Why not,' then it becomes 'Why not get drunk on tears'? It's still a weird sentence, but kinda... beautiful?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Oh, I read this wrong earlier, this word is supposed to be 'review' —why do they look so similar? 'read, review, browse,' They have similar meanings, and this one looks like a flying fowlbeast.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: A flying fowlbeast...? Wait, is this the one from the doorplate? ...'Reading Room,' a place where you can read books. Oh... so that's what it means.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: And that word from the other day that looks like two burdenbeasts, is 'prohibited,' and that means... 'not allowed.'

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: This one is 'movie,' the thing they invited me to last time. And 'catalog,' I've seen this in the cafeteria and infirmary... I got sidetracked. Let's move on.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...Alright, so this line could mean something more like 'We frantically spend our youth, trying to light up the night sky.'

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'So why not we get drunk on tears, and pretend to be a cluster of lost stars.'

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'Yet we hope to illuminate the other sky.'

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Huh... I still don't really get it. Why did they say 'Don't look at me, I am just a disappointed person, trying to get you back' at the end?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: What does that have to do with the stars, the night sky, getting drunk, and being young? The last few lines sound more like what Tom said to Katy after they broke up and he was trying to get her back...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I don't get it... what does it mean?
Frostleaf lies on the dormitory floor, her gaze wandering aimlessly across the notices and posters put up by her roommates on the walls.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Hmm...?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'Reading Room,' 'prohibited,' 'food and drink,' 'next week,' 'movie to watch,' 'catalog.'

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Is that what it means? The words I got wrong earlier are here too...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Woah, I can understand it?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: We frantically spend our youth, trying to light up the night sky♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: So why not we get drunk on tears, and pretend to be lost stars♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Yet we hope to light up another sky♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: It sounds so different now, like the words I heard the other day in that movie...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I finally finished checking all of it, and it doesn't seem that complicated. Seems like its just about romance?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Sounds like a young person wanting to get back together with their lover after they broke up, and they feel like a lost star...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: But I don't get what it means to light up the sky... Why would they want to do that?
Frostleaf puts away the vocabulary book in her hand, and crumples up several sheets of paper.
She stretches her neck, and walks out of the dormitory, where she had been for a long time.
The hall outside is still a hall, and the room is still a room, but—
'Instructions for Rhodes Island Operators'
'Today's Cafeteria Menu, featuring a Leithanian head chef!'
'Oranges sent from home, feel free to eat them!'
'Don't forget about the event in Perfumer's garden today!'
'The snack shelf has been restocked!'
She suddenly realizes she can understand all these previously meaningless symbols. The doorplates, the menus, the notices, they all have their own meanings.
In a way, it felt as if she suddenly belonged here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh, Frostleaf! Where are you headed?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I, I... Hold on, Frostleaf, wait up!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...'Rec Room'!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Like I was saying, Frostleaf, you put too much flour in, and now the meringue has collapsed and the biscuits are gonna come out real hard!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: See, just like I said, right?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: But you did great for your first try!

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Want to taste it yourself?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ...Oh, man! It really is hard as a rock!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Pfft, hahaha.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The meaning of 'Rec Room' is... a super hard biscuit.
Frostleaf opens her vocabulary book, and next to the words 'Rec Room,' draws a circle that could be seen as a biscuit with three small figures crowded together.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ......'Garden'!

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: You were called Frostleaf, yes?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: I don't know the meaning behind your codename, but it reminds me of the autumn leaves after the frost descends. Mm, a beautiful image.

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: Try smelling this fragrance, does it make you feel like you're in a maple forest with snow falling everywhere?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Mm... smells refreshing... and like dry leaves?

steps.name: Perfumer
steps.text: That's right, I concocted this one based on your name. It's alright if you didn't enjoy yourself today, but if you ever do spark an interest, you're always welcome.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: 'Garden' means... a maple forest after snow has fallen.
Frostleaf flips through the vocabulary book, finds the word 'Garden,' and draws a maple leaf next to it.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: ......And 'Cafeteria' is......

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If you can't read the medication instructions, then what about the menu?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Here, I'll explain it item by item. They have separate sections today: this side is by a Victorian chef, and that side is a Columbian chef. They both taste pretty good!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But you—you should eat from this section, where the food is both delicious AND nutritious!

spans.text: section, where the food is both delicious AND nutritious!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll read out the menu, and then you can decide what to eat, okay?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: The 'Cafeteria' is a place where I can fill my plate up everyday, with the diagrams Hibiscus drew for my pills.
Frostleaf draws a plate of food and a piece of paper covered with words.
Originally full of messy notes, page after page of the vocabulary book is filled with variety of small doodles, as if each word has taken on a new meaning.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Frostleaf!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Frostleaf—! Don't run away—the instructor told me to tell you we can ramp up our training exercises tomorrow!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: *pant* *pant*...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Jessica, can I borrow your pen again?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh? Yeah, here!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What are you drawing, a... table?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Yeah, on top of it are 'headphones,' 'vocabulary book,' and 'potted plants.'

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What's the small pot and shed next to 'wilderness' and the group of people next to 'battlefield'?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Ah, that's my life before I came here. We had a shed out in the wilds, and people would look for us when they needed something done. The lucky ones survived, most would never return.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That must have been hard...

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Erm...I don't know, actually. It's always been like that, ever since I was small. I was even a little uneasy coming here at first.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um, what did you draw next to the word 'hall'?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: A crying Feline's head.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I need to go training!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: And then... I'll look for Kroos and Perfumer. I have to thank them.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: And thank you, Jessica! When we're on the battlefield, we'll be epic squadmates!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: *pant*...*pant*...I finished the long-distance running mission... I feel alright, not too tired.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: My body should be fully recovered by now.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: We frantically spend our youth, trying to light up the night sky♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: So why not we get drunk on tears, and pretend to be lost stars♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Yet we hope to light up another sky♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Yet we hope to light up another sky♪

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Hmm... I guess you could interpret the lyrics this way too.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I'm like that lost star... but I also hope to light up the sky here.
Frostleaf looks up to the sky, the huge ship behind her roaring to life as it prepares to depart for its next destination.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: It's time to hand in my application to Dr. Kal'tsit. I'm pretty sure I'm ready to hit the battlefield!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: This is what the doctors wanted to see, right? My body's in tip-top shape, and I even gained some muscle.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: And with Engineering to help me repair my weapons, hmm... I might be even better in combat than ever!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit will definitely approve, and I can finally return to battle!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Finally... this is what I should be doing!
